Mission Local reported that a 16-year-old spent nearly three weeks in San Francisco County Jail after being booked under a different name and an adult age. The city took 20 days to verify he was a minor, despite an early alert. During that time, he was kept apart from adult inmates in C Pod, a special-needs unit; a judge ultimately ordered him transferred to juvenile hall and set bail at $10,000. The story said he faced drug-sale-related felony charges.
